note: Identifiers only. Remake freestanding rupees and recovery hearts: placed Obj_Rupee and Obj_Heart actors with a permanent row (reset type 24) whose hash no other catalog row holds. Names describe where the actor stands (2026-11-24 name audit). item is the placed actor, vanilla its item. region and rule follow the actor position checked on 2026-11-24 (basis gives the position). Left out: the Zora diving game rupees, actors with a Presence flag, and spots with no known check nearby. They join the shuffle with shuffle_freestanding_items set to all and hold any item.
